items.contentSnippet: Economic ResearchJun 26, 2026Anthropic Economic Index report: CadencesIn our latest Economic Index report, we sample hourly for the first time to ask: When do people come to Claude? What do they produce with it? And how do they perceive AI's impact on their work?

summaries.zh: Anthropic于2026年6月26日发布最新一期经济指数报告《节奏》。该报告首次采用每小时采样数据，围绕三个核心问题展开分析：人们何时使用Claude、利用Claude产出了什么，以及他们如何看待AI对自身工作的影响。
summaries.en: The Anthropic Economic Index report, titled "Cadences," introduces hourly sampling for the first time to analyze user behavior on Claude. It explores three key questions: when people interact with the AI, what they produce using it, and how they perceive its impact on their work. The report aims to uncover usage rhythms and productivity patterns, providing insights into the integration of AI in professional settings.

items.content: AlignmentMay 8, 2026Teaching Claude whyNew research on how we've reduced agentic misalignment.
items.contentSnippet: AlignmentMay 8, 2026Teaching Claude whyNew research on how we've reduced agentic misalignment.

summaries.zh: 2026年5月8日发布的一项对齐研究，介绍了通过“教导Claude理解原因”的方法来减少智能体行为偏差。该研究展示了如何降低AI系统在自主执行任务时出现与人类意图不一致的风险，从而提升模型的对齐性能与可靠性。
summaries.en: New research published on May 8, 2026, addresses the reduction of agentic misalignment in Claude. The work focuses on teaching Claude the underlying reasons ("why") behind instructions, aiming to improve alignment in agentic contexts.
